tools.name: publish_page
tools.description: Publish a new web page and get its public URL. Content is Markdown (GFM: tables, task lists, code fences) or HTML (sanitized: no scripts, forms or iframes; inline styles and <style> allowed). Returns the URL to show the user, plus live_url on Pro: a private live view that shows each update the momen

tools.name: update_page
tools.description: Replace the title, content, theme, byline, slug or expiry of a page you own. Omitted fields are kept. A new slug (Pro, or a minted page) changes the URL: the old link then shows 'revoked' and can't be reused. Minted pages stay permanent (expires_in_hours is ignored). Requires an API key (guest pages

tools.name: mint_page
tools.description: Make one page permanent with one mint: it never expires, loses the MintPage badge, gets Pro limits (2 MB, custom slug via update_page, indexable) and stops counting toward the live-page limit. Costs 1 mint from the account's balance, once per page; no charge if the page is already minted or the acco

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: List the pages in this account (newest first) with URLs, view counts and expiry. Requires an API key.

tools.name: delete_page
tools.description: Permanently take a page offline. The URL will show 'This page was removed'. Irreversible — confirm with the user first. Requires an API key.

tools.name: pause_page
tools.description: Temporarily hide a page (paused: true) or bring it back (paused: false). While paused, the URL shows 'This page is paused' to everyone except the signed-in owner; nothing is deleted and the URL doesn't change. Requires an API key.

tools.name: revoke_link
tools.description: Turn off a page's current link and give it a new random one, e.g. when the link reached the wrong people. The old URL shows 'This link was revoked' forever; content, stats and page_id are kept. Share the new url only with the right people. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_page_stats
tools.description: View count, last viewed time and a 30-day daily breakdown for a page you own. Requires an API key.

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: Comments left on a page's live session (Pro). People in the session draw a box on the page and write a comment; each comment has its text, who wrote it, the box (x, y, width, height in page pixels at the writer's page_width), the page text inside the box (text_in_box), the rendered HTML of the eleme

tools.name: resolve_comment
tools.description: Mark a live-session comment as done, with an optional short note shown to the people in the session (for example what was changed).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the current plan, usage against limits, and where to upgrade or get a key. Works for guests too.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, list_comments · Private data: publish_page, update_page, mint_page, list_pages, delete_page, pause_page, revoke_link, get_page_stats · Public sink: publish_page, revoke_link · Destructive: delete_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: publish_page, list_pages, list_comments · Private data: publish_page, update_page, mint_page, list_pages, delete_page, pause_page, revoke_link, get_page_stats · Public sink: publish_page, revoke_link · Destructive: delete_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
